//: Written descriptions of each incident type for zero-shot type suggestions with CLIP. scripts/ml/clip_text_embeddings.py turns these into src/BJK.Modules.Posts/Infrastructure/TypeSuggestions/type-prompts.json (embeddings). Baseline: ordinary scenes, so a type is only suggested when it fits better than 'nothing happening'.
baseline: a dashcam photo of ordinary traffic on a road
a dashcam view of a motorway with cars driving normally
a photo of a quiet residential street with parked cars
a dashcam photo of a town centre road with traffic lights

RoadRage: an angry driver getting out of a car and shouting at another driver
a person shouting and pointing at a car window in traffic
DangerousOvertaking: a car overtaking into oncoming traffic on the wrong side of the road
a car overtaking on a bend over double white lines
Tailgating: a car driving very close behind another car
a rear dashcam view of a car right on the bumper
MobilePhoneUse: a driver holding a mobile phone while driving
a person looking at a phone at the wheel of a car
Speeding: a car speeding fast down a road
a car racing past other traffic at high speed
RedLightRunning: a car driving through a red traffic light
a car crossing a junction while the traffic light is red
CuttingUp: a car suddenly cutting in front of the camera car to change lanes
a car swerving across lanes right in front of the dashcam
Undertaking: a car overtaking on the inside lane of a motorway
a car passing on the left in the slow lane
LaneHogging: a car driving in the middle lane of an empty motorway
a car staying in the outside lane with the other lanes empty
ClosePass: a car passing a cyclist very closely
a view from a bicycle as a vehicle passes inches away
BadParking: a car parked on the pavement blocking it
a car parked across a dropped kerb or on zigzag lines
a car parked badly across two parking spaces
